title: ricinocarpus laxiflorus
intro: Ricinocarpus laxiflorus, commonly known as the Chinese licorice vine, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits of immune system support and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ricinocarpus laxiflorus include its ability to clear heat, reduce fever, and relieve cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
